profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a driven and passionate computer science professional with over five years of hands-on experience in web and software development. As a Magna Cum Laude graduate from UMBC, I hold a Bachelor’s in Computer Science and a minor in Entrepreneurship and Innovation, blending technical expertise with a creative mindset for problem-solving and strategy.

My academic and professional journey has equipped me with a strong foundation in designing and implementing impactful solutions. Whether it’s developing user-friendly applications or tackling complex challenges, I bring a results-oriented approach and an entrepreneurial spirit to every project I undertake.

I am eager to continue growing as a developer while leveraging my skills to make meaningful contributions in the tech space. Let’s connect to discuss collaboration opportunities or explore how we can innovate together.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Develop and maintain web applications in JavaScript, React, Node.js ensuring
optimal performance and user experience.
• Create and optimize SQL queries using pgAdmin.
• Manage version control and collaboration with Git and Jira.
• Collaborate with teams to investigate and resolve software issues.

volunteerExperiences.description: Aiding in the development of engagement activities that deepen interest in computing and engineering for K-12 girls and other underrepresented groups

Passionate about education and college success, I had dedicated alot of my free time after graduating high school giving back to my high school. I’ve done alot of volunteering at PHS during my time there and have continued to come back to help out as needed every year since!

Some of my responsibilities included:
- Setting up/Cleaning Out classroom at the beginning and end of the year
- Facilitating Annual Alumni Panels 
- Conducting writing workshops for hundreds of high school juniors
- Supporting AP and Honors English 11 classes as required
